about_the_game: Vega Chronicle is a turn-based 4X space strategy game with streamlined logistics: no build queues, no population management. Explore the galaxy and discover planets to colonize. Build infrastructure to gain resources, discover advanced technologies, and raise a navy to conquer your rivals. Earn permanent bonuses to empower your next play-through with ancestral virtues, and build your legacy among the stars.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
